description: A data record: the data an observation rests on — a figure panel, a table or a data file. Maps to the MIRA schema's Entity, the range of observationBase (github.com/MIRA-science/schema, mira.yaml on main: observationBase, 'The data on which the observation is based', range Entity — prov:Entity, which MIRA imports from PROV-O), added to RRGI on 2026-10-03 for the IOSP room. Evidence links to it with tech.scios.rrgi.observationBase; one data record can be the base of several evidence nodes, and credit for it is given once, on the data record (tech.scios.rrgi.attribution). It is a node in the graph: it may be a bundle member, and versionOf / equivalentTo pair it with another data record (same kind). A figure panel or table names its paper (`doi`, and optionally the paper's `source` node), the page, the figure and panel, the region on the page and the verbatim caption; a data file names its `url`. A panel drawn by hand in the paper view carries the paper's `doi`, which is how views show it with that paper. Since 2026-10-04 the extraction pipeline's figure step (pipeline-v5) also writes them, one per panel, figure or table it finds in the PDF, as members of the paper's bundle; provenance.wasGeneratedBy then names the step (figure-panels or pdf-figures), and `conflicts` notes a value read from the panel that disagrees with the text. MIRA marks observationBase's range as provisional: mira.yaml's own comment on it reads "That range is very, very provisional. could also involve schema:DigitalDocument , schema:Dataset", so this shape may change when MIRA settles it. Like every RRGI node it is independently authored, content-addressed and carries provenance; intended to be proposed back upstream.

kind.description: What the data record is: a figure panel (one panel of a figure, or the whole of a single-panel figure), a table, or a data file. Open enum (knownValues).

text.description: The label shown for the data record, e.g. 'Figure 2, panel B' or the data file's name.

doi.description: The DOI of the paper the panel or table belongs to (bare or as a doi.org URL; views normalise it as they do bundle `doi:` tags).

source.description: Optional dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the paper's source node (tech.scios.rrgi.source), when one is in the graph. Advisory, like a bundle's members: a view that returns this data record does not promise to return that source too (the paper's version may be superseded or out of the view's layers), so a reader must not count on resolving it inside a view.

page.description: The page of the paper the panel or table is on, counting the PDF's first page as 1.

figure.description: The figure's number or label as the paper prints it, e.g. '2' or 'S3'.

panel.description: The panel's letter as the paper prints it, e.g. 'B'; absent for a single-panel figure, a whole figure, or a panel the paper prints no letter for.

region.description: Where the panel or table is on its page, in PDF points (1/72 inch), with the origin at the page's top-left corner and y counting downwards: x and y are the region's top-left corner, w and h its width and height. Whole numbers of at least 0 (ATProto has no floating-point numbers).

pageSize.description: The page's width and height in PDF points, so the region can be drawn at any scale. Whole numbers of at least 0.

caption.description: The verbatim caption, or for a panel the verbatim sub-caption, as the paper prints it.

imageHash.description: The content hash of the rendered crop of the region, as 'sha256:<hex>', so a copy of the image can be checked against the record.

conflicts.description: Where a value read from this panel disagrees with the paper's text (added 2026-10-04 for the figure step of the extraction pipeline, pipeline-v5): each entry names the text's evidence node, the evidence node stating what the figure shows, and a note on the disagreement. Either node may be absent (the producer could not name it); the note is always there. Views show the disagreement beside the panel so the paper's authors can see it.

url.description: Where a data file can be fetched.

region.description: Where the panel or table is on its page, in PDF points (1/72 inch), with the origin at the page's top-left corner and y counting downwards: x and y are the region's top-left corner, w and h its width and height. Whole numbers of at least 0 (ATProto has no floating-point numbers).

pageSize.description: The page's width and height in PDF points, so the region can be drawn at any scale. Whole numbers of at least 0.

text.description: The evidence node stating the value as the paper's text gives it.

figure.description: The evidence node stating the value as it was read from the figure.
